description: This source file defines the SecurityFactory class in the OFBiz framework, responsible for providing security-related instances and handling security permission checks. It includes the nested class OFBizSecurity, which implements security logic such as permission verification, user security data management, and role-based permission checks.

classes.name: SecurityFactory
classes.description: A utility class that provides methods to retrieve Security instances using Java ServiceLoader and manages a cache of security instances. It also contains a nested implementation class OFBizSecurity.

classes.name: OFBizSecurity
classes.description: An inner class implementing the Security interface, providing entity permission checks, role-based permission verification, and user security data management as per OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a Security instance for the given Delegator, using ServiceLoader to find an implementation or defaulting to OFBizSecurity.

methods.name: clearUserData
methods.description: Clears cached user security data based on the user login object.

methods.name: findUserLoginSecurityGroupByUserLoginId
methods.description: Retrieves security group data for a user login ID, deprecated.

methods.name: hasEntityPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission for a specific entity and action, with overloads for session objects.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has a given permission, with overloads for session objects.

methods.name: hasRolePermission
methods.description: Verifies if the user has permission within a specific role context, supporting various overloads for different parameters.

methods.name: securityGroupPermissionExists
methods.description: Checks if a security group permission exists, deprecated.
